## <span id="page-3-0"></span>**MetaQuotes certification program**

You think you know MetaTrader 5 inside out and have allthe skills needed to operate the platform for your broker successfully? Put your knowledge to the test and become a MetaQuotes certified professional.

- ·How to install and deploy the MetaTrader 5 trading cluster?
- ·How to protect against DDoS attacks and recover after a malfunction?
- ·How to create your own ECN and connect liquidity providers?
- ·How to configure the MetaTrader 5 platform to meet regulator requirements?
- ·What to do if the quotes have stopped and connection to the trade server has been lost?

These and many other questions arise in day to day brokerage activities. The answers are provided in this tutorial, in articles on the [Support](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/articles) Center website and in the MetaTrader 5 platform [documentation,](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/docs/mt5) but allthis still can't replace a specialist who knows WHAT to do in a specific situation and WHERE to find the necessary information.

Pass [certification](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/certification) from MetaQuotes to verify your knowledge and get the documentary evidence of your qualification for a broker.

![](_page_3_Picture_10.jpeg)

## **Through certification, you will**

- ·Test your knowledge
- ·Study relevant material and turn your weak points into strong ones
- ·Learn how to handle the existing functionality in depth
- ·Have an understanding of new product features
- ·Become a certified MetaQuotes professional
- ·Enrich your employment opportunities

### **Three types of certification**

- 1. MetaTrader 5 [Administrator](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/certification/courses/4) for platform administrators
- 2. [MetaTrader](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/certification/courses/6) 5 Manager for client managers
- 3. [MetaTrader](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/certification/courses/7) 5 Dealer for dealers and risk managers

#### **Free online test and two oral exam attempts**

Even if you are not confident in your abilities, start with the first certification stage — the online test. This test is free, while the number of attempts is unlimited. Check out the topics covered by the test and prepare for the certification.

If you feel confident about your knowledge and can easily pass the first stage, it will not be difficult for you to pass the second-stage interview. During the interview, we will additionally verify your knowledge before issuing a certificate. Even if your first interview attempt is unsuccessful, you will have a free retake attempt.

It is safe to say that getting a certificate is easier than obtaining a driver's license provided that you really spent some time behind the wheel and read the traffic code.

We offer one free certification for each company. [Order](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/certification) it now via the Certification section in MetaQuotes Support Center.

### **You are just a few steps away from becoming a certified professional**

Select the necessary certificate type and pass two stages:

- · Stage 1. Complete the online test consisting of approximately 80 multi-choice questions at your convenience. To complete the test, you should score 70% correct answers. Once you have successfully completed this test, you can then go on to sign up for stage two.
- · Stage 2. Pay for the oral exam and be interviewed by a MetaQuotes representative via a video call. The interview lasts for roughly 30 minutes and verifies that the results of the first stage are legitimate.

Successful participants receive an official certificate signed and verified by a unique 12-digit ID which proves authenticity. The document can be validated by using this [link](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/certification).

Enroll in the program now by going to the [Certification](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/certification) section on the MetaQuotes Support Center website. It takes less than 10 seconds.

## <span id="page-6-0"></span>**Platform installation**

The selection and preparation of hardware, as well as the correct installation of the MetaTrader 5 trading platform, are very important steps. They directly affect the platform reliability and the quality of your customer service.

In this chapter, we will cover all aspects of the platform installation:

- ·General platform operation principles and the interaction of its components
- ·Choosing a hosting provider, selecting hardware to meet the system requirements
- ·Preparing Windows for platform installation
- ·Installing the main and additional components for fully featured system operation
- ·Initial license activation and reactivation specifics

## <span id="page-7-0"></span>**Platform architecture**

The MetaTrader 5 trading platform is a distributed system. It is divided into separate components which are interconnected by the main trade server, where all settings are stored. Many functions are logically separated, which greatly improves the system reliability and performance.

![](_page_7_Figure_3.jpeg)

### **Trade server**

The system has two types of trade servers: one main server and additionaltrade servers. In addition to the functions of a trade server, the main server manages the system configuration and controls other servers. The trade server performs the following functions:

- ·Storing and managing client records
- ·Authenticating and authorizing client connections
- ·Storing and managing trade records
- ·Checking, managing and executing trade requests
- ·Managing the internal mail system.

Additionaltrade servers reduce main server load when the company has many clients. They store and manage a certain part of the client and trade databases, as well as manage trading activities.

See also: [Documentation](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/docs/mt5/platform/components/trade_server) / Platform / Platform components / Trade server

- ·The system can have one main trade server and an unlimited number of additional servers.
- ·All servers are configured via the **Network Cluster** section of the Administrator terminal.

#### <span id="page-8-1"></span>**Access server**

Access servers serve as proxy servers and platform firewalls. These servers perform the following functions:

- ·Handling incoming connections
- ·Packing and forwarding authorization requests to a trade server
- · Controlling the activity of client connections to protect the server from attacks and overload [\(Antiflood](#page-65-0) [Control](#page-65-0))
- · Storing history data, Market Depth data and news and providing them to clients to reduce the history server load
- ·Caching and providing Live Update updates to terminals
- · Monitoring cluster operation by observing history and trade servers. If the servers become unavailable, the system can automatically switch to backup servers.

An unlimited number of access servers can be installed for each trade server. Terminals switch between them automatically depending on priority settings.

See also: [Documentation](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/docs/mt5/platform/components/access_server) / Platform / Platform components / Access server

#### <span id="page-8-0"></span>**History server**

The history server processes price and news data. It performs the following functions:

- ·Receiving and filtering price and news data from gateways and datafeeds
- ·Packing price and news data
- · Storing and providing price history in the form of 1-minute bars and ticks to other components of the platform
- ·Storing and providing news
- ·Receiving, checking and distributing Live Update updates between MetaTrader 5 servers

See also: [Documentation](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/docs/mt5/platform/components/history_server) / Platform / Platform components / History server

#### <span id="page-9-0"></span>**Backup server**

These servers store backup data copies which can be used in case of a trade or history server failure. Backup servers perform the following functions:

- · Providing real-time backup of the trade and history server. Each server is associated with one or more separate backup server instances which can replace it at any time.
- ·Creating daily backups of all databases, creating regular backups of client and trade databases
- · For history servers: backing up data required for correct recovery of gateways, including user settings which can be stored in the settings.dat file under the gateway working directory (if provided by the gateway developer) and trade execution databases
- · Enabling automated switch to a backup server (failover) in case the primary server becomes unavailable to ensure the uninterrupted operation of the platform
- ·Enabling easy migration of servers to new equipment
- · Enabling fast manualrecovery even if the main trade server is unavailable and connection to the platform via MetaTrader 5 Administrator is impossible
- ·Replicating information to a MySQL, Firebird, MSSQL or Oracle database in realtime

See also: [Documentation](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/docs/mt5/platform/components/backup_server) / Platform / Platform components / Backup server

### **Data feeds**

The platform receives quotes and news from data feeds. Data feeds pass information to the [history](#page-8-0) server from which it is provided to [access](#page-8-1) points (data centers) and terminals. Data feeds are executable files (with the \*.exe extension) which run as separate processes.

The trading platform includes several data feeds which provide quotes and news from the most popular providers:

- ·Dow Jones Prime Tass News Feeder
- ·DJ News Feeder
- ·IQFeeder
- ·MetaTrader 4 Feeder
- ·MetaTrader 4 Host Feeder
- ·MetaTrader 5 Feeder

- ·Remote Datafeed

Additional data feeds are featured in the MetaQuotes Support Center App [Store](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/market/mt5/datafeeds).

See also: [Documentation](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/docs/mt5/platform/components/datafeeds) / Platform / Platform components / Data feeds

#### **Gateways**

Gateways integrate the MetaTrader 5 platform with externaltrading systems. Gateways enable the forwarding of trading operations to external systems, as well as transmitting quotes and news from them. Gateways are executable files (\*.exe) that run as separate processes.

The trading platform includes many gateways:

- ·MetaTrader 5 Gateway to Integral
- ·MetaTrader 5 Gateway to Euronext FX
- ·MetaTrader 5 Gateway to Cboe FX
- ·MetaTrader 5 Gateway to LMAX Exchange
- ·MetaTrader 5 Gateway to FXCM PRO

- ·MetaTrader 5 Gateway to MetaTrader 5
- ·MetaTrader 5 Gateway to MetaTrader 4

#### **Exchange Gateways**

- ·MetaTrader 5 Gateway to MOEX Securities (Moscow Exchange, Stock Market)
- ·MetaTrader 5 Gateway to MOEX Derivatives (Moscow Exchange, Derivatives Market)
- ·MetaTrader 5 Gateway to DGCX (DubaiGold and Commodities Exchange, Derivatives Market)
- ·MetaTrader 5 Gateway to GBOT (Bourse Africa, Derivatives Market)
- ·MetaTrader 5 Gateway to Ukrainian Exchange (Ukrainian Exchange, Stocks)

- ·MetaTrader 5 Gateway to Interactive Brokers

Additional gateways are featured in the MetaQuotes Support Center App [Store.](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/market/mt5/datafeeds)

See also: [Documentation](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/docs/mt5/platform/components/datafeeds) / Platform / Platform components / Gateways

#### **Administrator terminal**

MetaTrader 5 Administrator is a software program for the remote administration of the MetaTrader 5 trading platform. Through the terminal, the administrator can controlthe operation of servers and other platform components, manage settings for user groups, managers, financial instruments and data feeds. Also, the terminal enables the management of quote and tick databases, configuration of trading times and backups.

The trading platform provides enhanced configuration options. All of them are divided into categories and are conveniently presented in the Administration terminal.

See also: [Documentation](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/docs/mt5/platform/administrator) / Administrator

#### **Manager terminal**

MetaTrader 5 Manager provides essential client management, trade processing and reporting tools. In the terminal, dealers can process incoming orders manually and automatically, while risk managers can manage financial instrument settings and view data on uncovered positions. Accountants can conduct balance operations and create all kinds of reports. Furthermore, MetaTrader 5 Manager provides a plethora of other useful features.

See also: [Documentation](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/docs/mt5/manager) / Manager

#### **Client terminal for Windows**

The client terminal is the main working station of a trader, through which the trader can perform trading operations on financial markets. The terminal includes allrequired features to enable successful online trading, including technical and fundamental analysis, algorithmic trading, and the ability to trade from mobile devices. The client terminal supports all available trading instruments, such as forex symbols, options, futures and stocks.

See also: [Documentation](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/docs/mt5/client) / Client terminal

#### **Mobile terminal for iOS and Android**

With the MetaTrader 5 Mobile, users can controltheir accounts and trade in the financial markets from iOS and Android devices. Traders can access real-time quotes and analyze charts using dozens of popular indicators and graphical objects from anywhere in the world.

Special versions adapted for tablet computers are available for both operating systems.

#### See also:

- ·[Documentation](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/docs/mt5/iphone) / iPhone & iPad
- ·[Documentation](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/docs/mt5/android) / Android

#### <span id="page-12-0"></span>**WebTerminal**

MetaTrader 5 WebTerminal allows users to trade financial markets from a web browser. It works in all operating systems and browsers, without the need to install any additional software. The web terminal is safe to use, as all transmitted data is securely encrypted.

The web terminalfeatures alltypes of market and pending orders, and it supports one-click trading. Traders can view real-time quotes and analyze charts using basic graphical objects and 30 technical indicators.

See also: [Documentation](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/docs/mt5/client) / WebTerminal

#### **MetaTrader 5 APIs**

The MetaTrader 5 platform features open APIs which allow further expansion of the platform capabilities, integration with other trading systems and back-office components, as well as platform customization to fit specific business needs.

The platform provides five APIs and an additional option enabling real-time data export to an SQL database:

- ·Server API to expand MetaTrader 5 trade server functionality and change its operating logic.
- · Manager API to create and edit accounts, deposit and withdraw funds, process trade requests and manage server settings.
- · Gateway API to create custom gateways and data feeds to integrate the MetaTrader 5 platform with other systems.
- ·Report API to develop custom reports for MetaTrader 5 Manager.
- ·Web API to integrate the MetaTrader 5 platform with web resources and other services of the company.
- ·Export to SQL to export data to an SQL database in realtime and create reports.

See also: [Documentation](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/docs/mt5/api) / API

## <span id="page-14-0"></span>**Selecting hardware for platform installation**

Different approaches can be used when selecting hardware for your platform.

We recommend installing MetaTrader 5 on dedicated servers rented from hosting companies. However, this is not the only available option, and so you can use:

- · A dedicated server. This is a preferred option for installing the platform. Rent a machine with suitable parameters from a a hosting company. Many hosting companies offer dedicated servers, but this option is more expensive than a virtual machine.
- · A cheaper option is a Virtual Private Server (VPS). However, please note your trading platform will be running along with dozens of other operating systems on the same computer, which often leads to the insufficiency of resources. This solution can be used for testing and development systems, as well as for trading terminals. However, a VPS is unacceptable for trading platforms.
- · Your own managed virtualized infrastructure (for example, with VMWare/Hyper-V/Xen). You can rent a dedicated server and deploy the required infrastructure. Please note that we do not recommend hosting more than one virtual servers on a physical machine used for the trading platform operation.
- · A specialized virtualization solution from the provider. When selecting virtualization solutions from hosting providers, discuss with the provider alltechnical issues related to server loads in as much detail as possible. Resources availability must be fully guaranteed by the provider.

See also: Articles / How to choose a web hosting [provider](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/articles/977)

|                  | Minimum requirements                                                              | Recommended requirements                                                                                                               |
|------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| CPU              | Intel i7 11xx quad-core or more                                                   | Intel Xeon E3, E5 no less than quad-core (no older than 5 years)                                                                       |
| RAM              | No less than 16 GB                                                                | No less than 32 GB                                                                                                                     |
| Disk             | RAID-1 array with 2 x 1 TB drives                                                 | RAID-1 array with two 1 TB SSDs/NVMe for the trade server and the history server, RAID-1 array with 2 x 1 TB drives for backup servers |
| Network          | No less than 100 Mbps Internet connection for both incoming and outgoing channels | No less than 1 Gbps Internet connection for both incoming and outgoing channels                                                        |
| Operating system | Windows Server 2019 Standard x64                                                  | Windows Server 2022 Standard / Server Core edition                                                                                     |

### **Equipment requirements**

- ·The processor must support [AVX2](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/AVX) instructions to enable platform installation.
- · Choose a server configuration depending on the number of clients, financial instruments and the density of quotes stream. When databases grow, causing an increased load on the trading platform, even the initially recommended configuration may be failto cope with such load.
- · Due to the fact that the backup server is basically a duplicate of the main trading server, the configuration of the backup server should be similar or even identicalto the configuration of the main server. It is not recommended to place the backup server at the same hosting company as the main server, as it may happen that the entire network of the provider will be unavailable. Hosting the servers from different companies increases data security and the fault tolerance of the entire system.
- · The history server processes and stores large amounts of information. Therefore, the important criteria for the history server include the amount of disk space and data read/write speed.

## **Additional requirements**

- · No third-party software for system time synchronization is allowed, because cluster components [synchronize](#page-214-0) time with a reference server on their own.
- · Use virtualization if you have control over the hypervisor and can ensure enough resources for the virtual machine running MetaTrader 5. At least eight logical cores must be available to the virtual machine (virtual processors are specified here, unlike physical ones used for dedicated servers). The machine should support the Over-Provisioning technology and have the disk speed of no less than 30 MBps.
- · Configure BIOS on the server for use by low-latency applications: disable allthe energy saving features (including CPU C-state) and set memory usage parameters to the High Performance state.

### **Recommended basic cluster configuration**

We recommend renting at least two servers. Furthermore, it is advisable to have servers that are physically located in different data centers. One server will be used as the primary server. The second server will be used as a backup server. The primary server data is to be replicated to it in realtime.

Thus, even if one of the hosting providers has troubles, you will be able to restore the platform on the backup server. This configuration minimizes risks, as the probability of failure in both data centers is very small.

The following platform components should be installed on the primary and backup servers:

| Primary server    | Backup server                           |
|-------------------|-----------------------------------------|
| Main trade server | Backup server for the main trade server |
| History server    | Backup server for the history server    |
| Access server     | Access server                           |

Components can be installed in different physical servers within one data center, in order to provide a greater platform performance.

![](_page_16_Figure_1.jpeg)

## <span id="page-17-0"></span>**Preparing Windows for platform installation**

An important issue which directly affects the trading platform security and stability, is the configuration and optimization of your computer with the operating system.

This section covers the basic system preparation steps. However, please note that these are only recommendations. Use them at your own discretion and depending on your specific conditions and needs. After completing the configuration, please restart the server for the changes to take effect.

## **Configuring system updates**

In the control panel, enable automatic downloading of updates with manual confirmation of installation. The fully automated mode is not recommended as Windows does not allow the selection of the day on which updates should be installed. We recommend installing the updates on weekends, when the server load is minimal.

| Note: | Make sure to install all operating system updates, before installing the platform. |
|-------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|-------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|

#### **Disabling server roles**

Disable unnecessary server roles using the Server Manager. Run the Manager from the Administration section and complete all steps by clicking Next, until you see the list of server roles.

If any of the roles are active, select these roles and select Next. Skip the next step, where system components are configured, by clicking Next. At the confirmation step, check the list of roles to be removed and click Remove.

![](_page_18_Picture_2.jpeg)

### **Graphical interface**

First, it is recommended to configure a graphical user interface of the operating system. Disable anti-aliasing, shadows, menus, transition effects, etc. These settings provide faster operation with the server when using remote access.

Additionally, it is recommended to set a blank page as the home page in the internet browser properties.

## **Disable time synchronization**

Time synchronization on the server where the platform is installed must only be performed by the MetaTrader 5 main trade server. Windows Time sync service must be disabled.

The built-in MetaTrader 5 time sync service verifies and corrects time (if necessary) once an hour. Its settings are specified under the [Time](#page-214-0) section.

To disable time synchronization in the operating system, open the Date and Time section in the control panel. Navigate to the Internet Time tab, enter 127.0.0.1 in the Server box and uncheck the box next to automatic sync.

#### **Removing unnecessary programs**

Remove all unnecessary programs which can slow down the trading platform or negatively affect its security, such as:

- ·Web server (Internet Information Server, Apache, etc.)
- ·Mail server, DNS server, SNMP, etc.
- ·Databases (Oracle, MSSQL, and others)
- ·Various development environments (IDE), compilers
- ·Environments .NET and Java
- · Various control agents from the server manufacturer; usually this is a whole set of default programs designed for remote server monitoring.

Run the Add/Remove Programs wizard. Go to Programs and Features and uninstall all unnecessary programs. Remove programs at your discretion, depending on your needs and resource efficiency.

## <span id="page-22-0"></span>**Configuring Windows firewall**

The Platform installer (also used for fast deployment) automatically adds permissions for the required applications in Windows firewall.

If your platform configuration requires an additional port, navigate to Control Panel—Windows Firewall— Advanced settings. Create a new inbound rule and select the following:

#### **Configuring remote access**

Please keep the server remote access details in a safe place and do not share it with anyone without special need.

**Blocking RDP access with blank password.** Accounts for which no password is specified must not be able to remotely connect to the server.

Open Control Panel—Administration—Local Policies—Security options. Enable the option "Accounts: Limit local account use of blank passwords to console logon only".

| Policy                                                                   | Security Setting         |
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------|
| Account Policies                                                         | Block Microsoft accounts |
| Accounts: Guest account status                                           | Disabled                 |
| Accounts: Limit local account use of blank passwords to logon            | Enabled                  |
| Accounts: Rename administrator account                                   | Администратор            |
| Accounts: Rename guest account                                           | Гость                    |
| Audit: Audit the access of global system objects                         | Disabled                 |
| Audit: Audit the use of Backup and Restore privilege                     | Disabled                 |
| Audit: Force audit policy subcategory settings (Windows Vista and later) | Not Defined              |
| Audit: Shut down system immediately if unable to log security audits     | Disabled                 |
| DCOM: Machine Access Restrictions in Security Descriptor                 | Not Defined              |
| DCOM: Machine Launch Restrictions in Security Descriptor                 | Not Defined              |

**Changing standard port for remote connections.** To protect the server from attacks targeting "well-know" ports, we recommend changing the port for Desktop Protocol. Open regedit, go to

HKEY\_LOCAL\_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server\WinStations\RDP-Tcp and find the **Port Number** parameter. Double click on it, select Decimal base and specify the desired port.

![](_page_32_Figure_5.jpeg)

- ·The specified port must be allowed in [Windows](#page-22-0) firewall.
- · To connect to the server remotely, specify the new port after the IP address separated by a colon. For example, 10.59.162.3:5000.

**Limiting the list of IP addresses for remote connection.** As an additional security measure, you can restrict the list of IP addresses which can be used to remotely connect to the server. For example, you can allow connections only from your office addresses.

Open Windows Firewall and find Remote Desktop—User Mode (TCP-In) in the list of inbound rules. There may be several such rules depending on the number of network profiles. Open the one you need and go to the **Scope** tab. In the **Remote IP** address section, select "These IP addresses" and add the necessary ones to the list:

![](_page_33_Picture_5.jpeg)

## **Configuring antivirus software**

If antivirus software is used on your server, add to its exclusions the system processes of the MetaTrader 5 platform along with its installation directory. Constant monitoring by antivirus software reduces platform performance.

Here is an example of adding exclusions in Windows Defender, which is a built-in antivirus software used on Windows Server 2016. Open Windows Settings—Updates and Security—Windows Defender. Go to Exclusions and select **Add an exclusion**.

Select "Exclude process .exe, .com or .src". Specify the name of the platform component process in the window that opens. You can specify the name of the server executable file (for example mt5trade64.exe) or the name of the process (for example mt5msrv).

Similar exclusions should be added for all installed components of the cluster. The default names of the services are:

- ·mt5msrv for the main trade server
- ·mt5tsrv for an additionaltrade server
- ·mt5asrv for an access server
- ·mt5bsrv for a backup server
- ·mt5hsrv for a history server

If several components of the same type are installed, a digit is added to the service name. For example, mt5tsrv5. You can view the list of installed processes in the task manager.

## <span id="page-40-0"></span>**Installation of additional platform components**

After initial [installation,](#page-37-0) you receive a ready-to-tun trading platform. However, you should install additional components to ensure full-fledged and stable operation:

- ·Backup servers to which the platform can switch in case of primary server failure
- · Access servers in the main regions where you provide services to clients, to ensure optimal connection conditions
- ·Additionaltrading servers to reduce the load on the main trade when your customer base grows

### <span id="page-40-1"></span>**Installing additional backup servers**

Once the main platform part is installed, it is recommended to configure appropriate backup servers. The ability to ensure uninterrupted business operation is one of the main requirements set by financialregulators.

The MetaTrader 5 platform provides a separate component responsible for data security, the [backup](#page-9-0) server. It runs in parallel as an exact copy of the primary trade or history server. The backup server state is constantly synchronized with the primary server, enabling the system to switch to the backup server at any time. Furthermore, the backup process is resource efficient:

- · Critical and frequently changing data is synchronized in realtime. These include client and trade databases, platform settings, configurations and databases of gateway trade executions.
- · The rest of data is backed up every hour, including mail and news databases, files, executable files of gateways and data feeds and plugins.
  - · Always install backup servers which are the mandatory components of the platform. Trade and history servers do not create backups of databases.
  - · Multiple backup servers can be installed for each trade and history server, to minimize the risk of system failure.

During the full platform installation, a backup server is only created for the main trade server. It is installed on the same computer/disk, where the main components are installed. It only provides the minimum protection level, for example against the accidental deletion of the main server databases. However, in case of hardware failure, both the main and the backup server will be unavailable.

To ensure reliable platform operation, it is recommended to manually add backup servers for the history server, as well as for additionaltrade servers (if any). Such backup servers must be installed separately from the main servers, on separate computers.

The easiest way to install a server is to configure it in the MetaTrader 5 Administrator terminal and then to use the deployment function.

Before deploying a server, be sure to configure server network parameters: the password that will be used by other cluster components for connection to the backup server, as well as the IP addresses through which the

new server will send and receive data. Allthese parameters will be registered in the server installation package. Thus, all other cluster components will be able to connect to the backup server immediately after installation, while you will be able to manage the server via the Administrator terminal.

When configuring backup server parameters, you should find balance between the frequency of backups and the available disk space on the computer where the backup server is installed:

- · **Backup time**, when file copies will be created. In addition to real-time state synchronization with the main server, the backup server creates daily database file copies on a disk. Such copies allow [restoring](#page-120-0) the primary server status as on a specific day.
- · **Additional backups**. Specify here the frequency of creation of additionalfile copies. By default, file copies are created every 24 hours, but you can set a more frequent custom period, once an hour or 4 hours. However, please note that more frequent backups require more server resources and more disk space. This option is only available for trade server backups. Backup copies of history servers are always created once every 24 hours.
- · **Keep backups** is file copies storage period. All backup copies older than the specified period are automatically deleted.
- · **Enable tick backups**. This parameter should be enabled with caution, because tick data take up too much space. If you choose to back up tick data, set short copy storing period so that they do not consume allthe available disk space.
- · Repeat the procedure and install backup servers for other platform components, including the history server and all other trade servers. Install backup servers separately from the primary servers, on separate computers.
- · Install assess servers close to the backup ones. These access servers will be used for client connections in case the platform switches to the backup servers.

### <span id="page-44-0"></span>**Additional access servers**

It is recommended to install additional access servers in order to improve system performance and reliability. Access servers process client connections, cache data, and protect the platform from DDOS attacks. They also monitor the availability of the trade and history servers to enable the operation of the [automatic](#page-115-0) failover [system.](#page-115-0)

Connection to the entire trading platform is only available through access servers. If you decide to use one server and it fails, neither administrators nor traders will be available to connect to the platform. In addition, the entire connection processing load will be handled by one server, which can negatively affect the system performance.

Access servers can be installed using the previously described [deployment](#page-40-1) procedure.

See also: Video / How to install an [additional](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/articles/1015) access server

We recommend installing several access servers on separate computers. The platform analyzes the current load on each server and effectively distributes client connections between them.

#### **Priority settings**

After installation, configure the rest of the server parameters under the [Network](#page-57-0) cluster section.

The preference of an access server for connecting client terminals to the trade server is determined by the server priority and the connection quality. The lower the priority value, the more preferred the server is for clients. The base priority (from 1 to 15) can be specified in server settings, which determines server preference when all other conditions are equal.

The final analysis of the access server concerns the connection quality (ping) and the current priority, which depends on the base priority and the number of current connections. Server connection quality is shown in client, manager and administrator terminals based on the same data.

![](_page_45_Figure_2.jpeg)

The current priority is calculated using the following formula: *Current Priority = (Base Priority + Connections / 1000)*,

where:

- ·**Current Priority** is the current server priority
- ·**Base Priority** is the base priority specified in server settings
- ·**Connections** is the number of current connections

Every 1000 client connections increase the server's current priority by one. The current priority of the access servers can be viewed in the **Network Cluster** section.

In Permissions, specify connection types allowed for the access server:

- ·**Allow Client Terminal connections**. Client terminals are allowed to connect to this access point.
- ·**Allow Manager Terminal connections**. Manager terminals are allowed to connect to this access point.
- · **Allow Administrator Terminal connections**. Administrator terminals are allowed to connect to this access point.
- · **Allow Manager API connections**. Applications written using [Manager](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/docs/mt5/api/managerapi) API are allowed to connect to this access point.
- · **Allow Web API connections**. Applications written using [Web](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/docs/mt5/api/webapi) API are allowed to connect to this access point.

In the **Servers** section, select the trade servers to which users will connect through the selected access server.

#### **Additional trade servers**

As the company grows and the number of active clients increases, you can install additionaltrade servers in order to remove some load from the main server. It is recommended to install an additionaltrade server in the same data center, where the main and history servers are located. Trade servers should not be located far from the history server, in order to avoid delays when delivering quotes and sending trading operations to external systems through gateways.

After the installation of an additionaltrade server, it is recommended to install its backup server in a different data center, where the backup servers of the main and history servers are running.

Additionaltrade servers can be installed using the previously described [deployment](#page-40-1) procedure. After installation, configure all other parameters in the [Network](#page-57-0) cluster section.

#### **Automatic creation of the first administrator account**

According to the platform architecture, an administrator/manager can only work with accounts and databases on the trade server, where the administrator or manager account (its group) is located. For example, when connected to the main server, the administrator/manager can't create accounts on additionaltrade servers. In order to connect to the additionaltrade server and to manage its accounts, the administrator or manager needs to have an account on this server.

When you install an additionaltrade server, one administrator account is automatically created on it. The first free login available in the range of accounts specified for the server will be given to the administrator account.

Here ID is the internal [identifier](#page-58-1) of the added trade server.

- · The administrator account and groups can only be created after specifying the range of accounts. It can be specified when adding a server or when editing it. In other words, once a trade server with the specified account range is added, groups and a manager account are automatically created for this server. If you configure the range before running the [deployment](#page-40-1) procedure, the administrator account and the groups will be created during server installation.
- · A password for the manager account is generated randomly. The login and password of the created account are written to the server's log file (the /Logs folder). The log looks like this: default manager with login '1000' and password 'lfd5fircvs' added
- · The first time you connect using the automatically created administrator account, you will be prompted to change the account password.

#### **Launching the server**

For the newly added server to start functioning, restart the entire platform (the main trade server). After the system restart, the following operations are performed automatically:

- · An account in the manager\administrators-ID group is created for the automatically generated administrator account. If the group does not exist for some reason, an account will be created in another manager group available on the server.
- · If additional accounts were created in the Manager section before restarting the system, and the logins of these accounts fall into the account range of the added server, accounts in appropriate groups will also be created for them.

## <span id="page-53-0"></span>**Setting up a platform for testing new features and developing your own solutions**

In addition to the main working platform, you can install a free testing (development) platform. You can use it to test new platform settings and to develop applications using MetaTrader 5 API, without affecting your current working processes. It is also recommended to install beta updates on a test platform, in order to explore new features in advance and to test the operation of third-party applications before updating your working platform.

To request a test platform license, please contact MetaQuotes [Service](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/support) Desk.

The test license is a complete analogue of the main license (including the limitation on the number of accounts), but it has the following differences:

- ·The server name in the license shows Test. This name is displayed in allterminals.
- ·Server [activations](#page-55-0) under this license can't be set as main.

The following restrictions apply to servers installed under a test license:

- · The server is not included in the list of servers available in the desktop terminal. It is possible to connect to the account only by specifying the access server address manually.
- ·Connection to the server via mobile platform and web [terminal](#page-12-0) is not possible.
- ·The server does not allow sending push [notifications](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/docs/mt5/manager/push_notifications) via the Manager terminal and the API.
- ·Allocation of a [VPS](https://www.mql5.com/en/vps) for an account opened on a server running under a test license is not allowed.
- ·An account opened on a server running under a test license can't be registered as a trade [signal](https://www.mql5.com/en/signals).

See also: Articles / [MetaTrader](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/articles/437) 5 debug servers for plugin developers

## <span id="page-54-0"></span>**Platform activation**

After platform [installation](#page-37-0), activate its license. Before activation, the platform operates with the following restrictions:

- ·Only one trade server (main) can be installed in the system.
- ·No more than 100 users can be created.
- ·A maximum of five groups can be created, including four default groups.

Open the server [start](#page-137-0) page and click **Activate now**:

![](_page_54_Picture_7.jpeg)

The following actions are performed during activation:

- ·A request is sent to the developer's update server.
- · If the license is verified successfully, a new activated license is generated, which is linked to the configuration of the server where the platform is installed.
- ·The activated license is sent back to the trade server.

- ·The number of activations is limited. Typically, up to 5 activations are allowed for one license.
- · During activation, the system automatically downloads and installs the latest versions of all components of the trading platform.

An individual activations list with the following details is displayed for each license of the platform:

- ·**IP** — the IP address from which the platform was activated.
- · **Build** — current platform build. If the build is shown in red, then an update is available for the platform. We recommend installing the latest versions, as they increase the platform stability and expand its capabilities.
- ·**Created** — platform activation date.
- · **Active** — the date of the last update of platform data (including build). Platforms send service information to the server every 24 hours, during [optimization](#page-61-0) hours. The active time is updated every time when the platform sends data. If no data is received for one month, the date will be shown in red to warn of server inactivity. If the platform does not update the data for three months, it will be automatically removed from the list of available servers in terminals, as well as from the [Signals](https://www.mql5.com/en/signals) and Virtual [Hosting](https://www.mql5.com/en/vps) services.

Two platform [activation](#page-54-0) types are available: primary (shown in bold) and non-primary.

- ·Client terminals can only connect to the platform with the primary activation.
- · To enable client terminal connections, the platform sends information about its access points (installed access servers) to the update server every hour. Information is sent to the server regardless of the activation type. However, only the primary activation access points are sent to the terminals.

· Servers with non-primary activation are not shown in broker selection dialogs when opening an account through terminals.

To make a platform activation primary, please contact MetaQuotes [Service](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/support) Desk.

- · If you migrate the platform to another server and activate it, the new activation will appear in the list as non-primary. As soon as you complete the platform preparation, be sure to contact the Service Desk to set the activation as primary. Otherwise, traders may have connection issues, since terminals will not know new access points.
- · Desktop terminals receive the relevant information about access points every time the trader connects to an account. To ensure the availability of this information after platform migration to new hardware/hosting provider, it is recommended to leave at least one old access point running for 1-2 weeks.
- · Activation is linked to server hardware. When you change the computer configuration, you can see a new activation from the same IP address in the list. If the list of access points has not changed, this will not affect server operation with client terminals. However, we recommend that you contact the support team to set the new activation as primary.

You can delete the old activation by selecting . If you do not have enough permissions to delete an activation, or if you do not see the server management section, please contact the Service Desk.

#### **IPv4 and IPv6 support**

IPv4 which is used in every network was created more than 30 years ago. It contains IP addresses of 32 bits, which are represented as four 8-bit numbers separated by dots. This produces more than four billion unique IP addresses. However, the rapidly growing number of users and devices has accelerated the depletion of the pool of available addresses.

To avoid the depletion problem, products started to provide additional support for the modern IPv6. This protocol uses 128-bit addresses, represented as x:x:x:x:x:x:x:x, where each x is a hexadecimal value of six 16 bit address elements. Theoretically, this format allows 5 x 10 ^ 28 unique addresses. In addition to an extensive address space, this protocol has other advantages over the older version. You can read about them in specialized articles.

The platform supports two network protocols: IPv4 and IPv6. The corresponding addresses can be specified as outgoing, listen and public.

To use IPv6, please make sure this protocol is supported by your network infrastructure.

#### **Outbound connection address**

The outbound connection address is used for the following purposes:

·Making outbound connections to other servers. · Authenticating the server by IP address. During connection, the server address specified in these settings is checked against the address from which the connection is actually established.

Use the left field to bind to an IPv4 address. The address is specified as IP-address:port, for example: 192.168.0.1:3128.

Use the right field to bind to an IPv6 address. If a port is specified for the address, the main part must be enclosed in brackets: [address]:port.

#### **Listen addresses**

Listen (binding) address is the address and port that the access server will listen on for external connections. It is recommended to specify the IP address for binding, not the domain name.

You can specify here the localIP address of the access server or the external one, depending on the network configuration:

- · If the access server has direct access to the internet and is not closed by a firewall, specify here the external IP address
- · If the local network uses access to the internet through a firewall, you should configure correct routing of incoming connections to the internalIP address of the access server. In this case, specify the local address of the server in this tab.
- · In order to configure listening on a specific port on all available addresses, specify 0.0.0.0:port number. For example, 0.0.0.0:443.

#### **Public addresses**

Specify here a list of public access points (IP or DNS addresses) through which connections from other platform components, client connections from terminals and APIs (for access servers) will be accepted.

When other cluster components connect to the server, they sequentially iterate over its public addresses in the same order in which they are listed. If a domain name is specified as a public address, servers will iterate over all associated IP addresses, while preference is given to IPv6.

If you check "Automatically use as public addresses", the specified listen addresses will be used as public addresses.

The following parameters should be specified here:

- ·**Network adapter** — the network adapter that will be used to [monitor](#page-140-0) the server state.
- <span id="page-61-0"></span>· **Optimization time** — server optimization time. During optimization, different operations are performed aimed to increase the server performance. During this time, the system deletes expired demo accounts, optimizes databases, and updates components. Select the time when the server load is the lowest. For example, 03:47 AM server time.

#### **Cluster optimization process**

Certain operations are performed sequentially during optimization time. Some operations are performed daily, others only on Sundays.

If the optimization start time is set to 1:00 AM, the process will proceed as follows:

#### **Trade server**

- · 1:00. Daylight Saving Time settings are checked. If the clock has turned backward or forward, the server is restarted to apply changes.
- ·1:00 +/– a few seconds. Computer performance data is collected.

Further, no operations are performed on all days except Sunday. The following operations are performed on Sunday:

- · 1:10. Compacting databases and configurations (deleting unnecessary and empty records), deleting expired demo accounts, restarting the server.
- ·2:00. Checking updates; updating and restarting the server if necessary.
- ·3:00. Zipping server logs for the previous week.

#### **History server**

- ·1:00 +/– a few seconds. Computer performance data is collected.
- ·1:10. Compacting databases and configurations (deleting unnecessary and empty records).

Further, no operations are performed on all days except Sunday. The following operations are performed on Sunday:

- ·2:00. Checking updates; updating and restarting the server if necessary.
- · 2:20. Launching tick and minute history optimization. The data of financial instruments that are not available in the platform are deleted from the \history\ directory.
- ·3:00. Zipping server and gateway logs for the previous week.

#### **Access server**

- ·1:00 +/– a few seconds. Computer performance data is collected.
- ·1:10. Compacting databases and configurations (deleting unnecessary and empty records).

Further, no operations are performed on all days except Sunday. The following operations are performed on Sunday:

- ·2:00. Checking updates; updating and restarting the server if necessary.
- · 2:20. Launching tick and minute history optimization. The data of financial instruments that are not available in the platform are deleted from the \history\ directory.
- ·3:00. Zipping server logs for the previous week.

#### **Backup server**

- ·1:00 +/– a few seconds. Computer performance data is collected.
- ·1:10. Compacting databases and configurations (deleting unnecessary and empty records).

Further, no operations are performed on all days except Sunday. The following operations are performed on Sunday:

- ·2:00. Checking updates; updating and restarting the server if necessary.
- ·3:00. Zipping server logs for the previous week.

## <span id="page-63-0"></span>**Common errors and recommendations**

- ·Do not forget to install all operating system updates as this increases the operation stability.
- · Do not use older operating systems as they may not support allthe features required for the quick and reliable platform operation.
- · Do not shrink the paging file. It must be managed by the system. This is a required condition for a correct platform operation.
- ·We do not recommend using hardware older than three years for the platform.
- · At least one access server must be installed in the same location as the main server. Such collocation reduces network latency.
- · The history server must be installed in the same location as the main server, otherwise you quotes may be transmitted with a delay.

## <span id="page-64-0"></span>**Platform security**

Ensuring trading platform security is the direct responsibility of the administrator. This complex task includes not only monitoring and maintaining hardware, but also controlling employee access to data, protecting against network attacks, protecting traders' data, and much more.

In this chapter, we will cover primary administration task, such as:

- ·How to protect against DDoS attacks using built-in anti-flood control
- ·How to control connections to the platform using the built-in firewall
- ·How to protect against DDoS attacks using external service providers
- ·How to set up platform access rights for your company's employees
- ·How to provide additional account security using SSL authentication and one-time passwords

## <span id="page-65-0"></span>**Configuring anti-flood control**

The anti-flood control system runs on access [servers.](#page-8-1) It protects the trading platform from external malicious attacks. The protection system collects a database of users who send invalid requests to the server (for example, an attempt to authorize with an incorrect username or password), as well as of users who send too frequent requests.

Anti-flood control is effective for alltypes of connections to the server, including manager connections (via the Manager terminal or Manager API).

#### **How the system works**

The anti-flood control system monitors user activity. Users are identified by their IP addresses as well as by the ID linked to their computers and operating systems. The following two activity types are controlled:

#### ·**The total number of connections from one user**

The system tracks if a user creates too many connections. When a user connects to the server, their connection counter is incremented by one. If the next connection occurs in less than 3 seconds, the counter is incremented. If the specified time interval is exceeded, the counter is reset. When the counter reaches the number specified in the Connections box, the user is blocked for 5 minutes. The blocking period increases if the connections limit is reached again. The maximum blocking period is one hour.

#### ·**Number of invalid packets from one user**

The system blocks brute-force attacks by analyzing authentication errors, which imply multiple login attempts with incorrect data. Also, the system detects garbage flood packets, which can be sent to the server by third-party utilities in an effort to reduce the server performance (i.e. a DoS attack). When a user sends an invalid packet to the server, the user's error counter is incremented by one. If the next invalid packet is sent in less than 5 minutes, the counter is incremented. If the specified time interval is exceeded, the counter is reset. When the counter reaches the number specified in the Errors box, the user is blocked for 5 minutes. The blocking period increases if the connections limit is reached again. The maximum blocking period is one hour.

When a user is blocked, the following entries are added to the access server log:

- ·*IP* is blocked after *N* connections [intruder] — if the user was banned by IP after *N* connection attempts.
- · *CID* is blocked after *N* errors [intruder] — if the user was banned by computer identifier (CID) after sending *N* invalid requests.
  - ·We strongly recommend that you do not disable the anti-flood control system.
  - · The anti-flood control system does not check the IP addresses from the "always allowed" list in [platform](#page-67-0) firewall settings.

## <span id="page-67-0"></span>**Configuring firewall**

The firewall is designed to protect the platform from access from unwanted IP addresses. If you detect suspicious activity from a group of addresses, add a deny rule for them; in this case no user (client, manager, administrator) will be able to connect to the server form these addresses. At the same time, you can add the desired addresses to the allowlist, for example, those used in your office. Such addresses will not be blocked by the [anti-flood](#page-65-0) control system, even if high activity is registered from these addresses.

![](_page_67_Picture_3.jpeg)

All addresses are considered to be allowed by default, and all addresses are checked by the anti-flood control mechanism.

To protect the system, create a set of allow and deny instructions, taking into account the following rules:

- · The latest rule is applied to an address, regardless of previous instructions, except for the addresses that are always allowed.
- ·Each address is checked from top to bottom.

Thus, the position of each instruction in the list is a very important factor when configuring access from IP addresses.

Here is an example of two instructions:

- ·Denied: 192.168.0.0 — 192.168.0.100
- ·Allowed: 192.168.0.20 — 192.168.0.60

The allow instruction is located lower in the list than the deny rule. This allows the creation of an allowed interval within the range of blocked addresses. Addresses in ranges 192.168.0.0 — 192.168.0.20 and 192.168.0.60 —

192.168.0.100 will be blocked. But if you reverse these instructions, the entire range 192.168.0.0 — 192.168.0.100 will become blocked.

To rearrange rules, drag them in the list or use the arrows on the toolbar.

### **Rule parameters**

Each instruction specifies the type of action to be applied to the indicated address range:

- ·Block
- ·Permit
- · Permit always — these addresses are always allowed regardless of any deny instructions above or below; they are not subject to anti-flood checks

Next, specify the range of addresses to which the action should be applied. To set a rule for only one address, indicate this address on both fields, **From** and **To**.

Additionally, you can add a comment to the rule for easier navigation. For example, you can mention the location, such as Office network, London office, etc.

To quickly add instructions for any IP-address, paste it into the Comment field from the clipboard. After you click OK, the address will be automatically added to fields **From** and **To**.

- · Do not block address ranges that include the IP address used for connection from the Administrator terminal. After the activation of such a rule, you will not be able to connect to the server.
- · If you accidentally block your own IP address and you can't log in under any other administrator account, the only solution is to stop the main server service, to delete the [main server installation directory]config\access.inifile and to restart the server. This willremove any previously created firewall settings.
- · The rules take effect as soon as you click OK, but apply only to new connections. Current connections are not reset.

## <span id="page-69-0"></span>**Enabling anti-DDoS protection**

The access servers of the platform are provided with the anti-DDoS protection mechanism. The mechanism monitors the network activity of clients in realtime and blocks connections from the IP addresses on which suspicious activity is registered, such as sending too many requests, submission of invalid data, authorization errors, etc.

Unfortunately, the mechanism can't protect the platform against all existing types of attacks. For example, it can't defend against attacks targeting the network infrastructure, since such attacks cannot be physically dealt with at the access server application level. Additional mechanisms are required for effective protection.

The trading platform provides a special component Anti-DDoS Proxy Server. The component enables the use of external anti-DDoS service providers. In this case, blocking of unwanted connections is performed on the distributed network of anti-DDoS provider's servers rather than on access servers. The anti-DDos provider's server network actually acts as an additional component between the client and the access server.

Instead of directly connecting to access servers, all clients will be connected to the provider's public access points. Unwanted connections will be filtered in the provider's own network of servers, while legitimate connections from real clients will pass through to access servers.

The broker's infrastructure is practically not affected.

## **Configure your access server for the operation with an external anti-DDoS service provider**

Choose an access server, to which the connections via the anti-DDoS provider will be redirected. It is recommended to install and configure a new access server, because its address must not be publicly known (otherwise attackers will be able to directly attack this server). If you have an access server that was not visible to clients (had the Idle priority or client connections were disabled in its settings), you may use this server.

See also: [Documentation](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/docs/mt5/platform/administration/admin_network/network_add_edit/network_access_server) / Platform / Platform setup / Network cluster / Configuring servers / Access [servers](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/docs/mt5/platform/administration/admin_network/network_add_edit/network_access_server)

The **Hide server from all types of terminals (connections will be allowed)** option is available for servers that work with an external anti-DDoS provider.

#### **Choose an anti-DDoS service provider and receive necessary data**

You should contact the anti-DDoS provider and sign an appropriate agreement. At the moment, the platform supports the following providers: [Akamai,](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/market/product/194) [Qrator](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/market/product/477), [Cloudflare](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/market/product/478). Support for other providers will be added later.

- ·Provide information about the public address of your access server to your anti-DDoS provider.
- · The provide will allocate one or more public addresses, to which your clients will be connected. These addresses should be specified in the Anti DDoS Proxy Server [settings](#page-72-0) in the Public Addresses box.

· Also, you will be receive ranges of proxy server addresses through which client connections will be forwarded to access servers. These ranges should be specified in the Anti DDoS Proxy Server settings (Source [Subnets\)](#page-72-1). The ranges are used as an additional protection measure: connections forwarded by the anti DDoS provider will only be accepted from these addresses.

See also: [Documentation](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/docs/mt5/platform/administration/admin_network/network_add_edit#network) / Platform / Platform Setup / Network Cluster / Configuring Servers

Note that this name will be used for the access points displayed in client terminals. Do not use phrases like Anti DDoS and similar, as the point should look like a regular access server.

After you finish configuring Anti DDoS, the server will be available for client connections. The provider's server is displayed as a regular access point in client terminals:

### **How to hide access servers**

After the configuration of the Anti-DDoS proxy server, the provider's access point will be available for all terminals, including client, manager and administrator. However, your access servers will still be available to these terminals.

If a server address is publicly available, attackers can find out this address and perform an attack. You can hide access servers in order to protect them from possible attacks. This can be done by enabling the option **Hide server from all types of terminals (connections will be allowed)**.

By hiding a server, you do not disable the possibility to connect to it. Terminals can connect to this server if the address is specified manually, while the anti-DDoS provider can redirect client connections to it.

### **How to identify connections through the anti DDoS provider**

Forwarded client connections are received from the anti DDoS provider's addresses. However, the real original addresses of clients are also known; they are transmitted by the provider. The proper original client's address is written to the platform logs and client records (e.g. in the **Last IP** parameter).

Check the access server journalto find out if the client is connected via the anti DDoS provider:

```
2017.10.13 17:42:08.441 84.101.15.116 '1814046': login (Client build 1674,
cid: 13ea0a897463ba4aeb76db5d8cdc4afa, ping: 108.83 ms, anti ddos server: 81.230.104.100)
```

# <span id="page-75-0"></span>**Granting different platform access permissions to company employees**

User accounts in the platform are trading accounts. They are used for traders, as well as for the broker's managers and administrators. The latter ones have a special manager configuration add-on over the trading account. This configuration assigns advanced rights and turns a regular account into a manager or administrator account.

All accounts, including trader and manager, are created in [groups](#page-180-0). Groups enable efficient management of common account settings, such as access to trading instruments, authorization parameters and others.

When you installthe platform, two groups are immediately created for broker accounts:

- · managers\administrators — an account group for administrators who manage platform settings, manage databases, etc. The first administrator account with the login 1000 is created in this group.
- ·managers\dealers — a group for manager accounts (dealers) who work with clients, process trades, etc.

These two groups are enough for the initial access setup. Later, you can add additional groups: for additional trade servers, for your White Label, etc.

See also: [Documentation](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/docs/mt5/platform/administration/admin_groups) / Platform / Platform settings / Groups

#### **General recommendations**

- · All company employees should use only corporate email addresses. This ensures greater control and reduces the risk of information leakage.
- · The server administrator should disable the display of client account details to those managers who do not need such data for their official duties. For example, managers who send out news and analytical market reports, do not need access to client account details.
- · The server administrator should restrict managers' access to the data history. If the manager needs access to information for the last 30 days, then you should set 30 days in the **Available Reports** parameter in manager account settings.
- · The server administrator must carefully monitor manager access rights in relation to client groups on the server.
- · The fewer server administrators you have (managers with the right to connect via MetaTrader 5 Administrator), the better.

Fill in allthe required fields: name, company, country, etc. Properly created accounts enable efficient operation in the future. For each account, it should obvious whom it belongs to.

#### **General settings**

Specify the following parameters in the general settings section:

- · **Login** — the number of the account based on which the manager account will be created. The account must be included in the manager group.
- · **Mailbox name** — the name of the manager in the mail system. The trading platform allows contacting traders via the internal email system. The specified name will be displayed in the From field in emails sent by the manager. If the trader wants to contact the broker, the manager account will be shown in the list of available recipients in the To field. If the mailbox name is not specified, the manager will not be able to send internal emails.
- · **Groups** — [account](#page-180-0) groups to be managed by this manager account. The manager will have access to accounts and trading operations only within the specified groups. Group rules are checked in a top to bottom order. If you allow all groups in the first line, you will not be able to prohibit some of them with further rules.

You can use mask \* and negation sign ! to indicate groups. For example, demo\* means all groups whose names (including the path) begin with "demo" characters (for example, demo\forex, demoforex, demoforex\usd). If you specify !managers,\*, all groups will be taken into account, except for those whose names begin with the characters "managers".

A rule can't contain only a group deny. For example, rule !demo\* is incorrect. A deny rule can only be combined with permissions for other groups. For example, !demo\*,real\*.

## <span id="page-84-0"></span>**SSL authentication**

To ensure a high level of account security, the trading platform supports extended validation through SSL certificates. In this mode, users utilize SSL certificates for logging in, in addition to standard credentials. A certificate can be automatically generated and issued to a client when the client first connects to the trades server. Optionally, you can use your own certificate: generate it using third-party software, issue it to the client, and import the certificate to the account on the trade server side.

### **Generating certificates on the server**

The trading platform provides a mechanism for the automatic generation of client certificates. The certificate can be generated in different ways:

- · Based on a certificate from the license to the trading platform. The license contains a certificate specially issued by MetaQuotes for each specific company.
- · Based on any other certificate which can be used to generate certificates. Such a certificate must contain a private key.

You can select one of the above options under the **Security** / **Certificates** section, in the **Issue** field.

![](_page_84_Picture_8.jpeg)

When authorizing on the server with a certificate, the certification authority is checked. Authorization is allowed only with certificates issued by trusted authorities. By default, such an authority is a certificate from the trading platform license, which is used to generate client certificates.

To add another certification authority, click the appropriate button and specify the \*.cer or \*.crt file. If necessary, any of the previously added certification authorities can be disabled at any time.

See also: [Documentation](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/docs/mt5/platform/administration/security/security_certificates) / Platform / Platform settings / Security / Certificates

#### **Setting up a client group**

To enable extended validation for client groups, open the **Common** tab and select a certificate generation option in the **Authentication** tab: 1024-bit RSA SSL certificate or 2048-bit RSA SSL certificate. 2048-bit encryption offers a higher level of security, but certificate generation can be slower. 1024-bit encryption is sufficient in most cases.

#### **Confirmation of certificates**

For added security, you can enable manual confirmation of certificates generated for clients (the **Enable certificate confirmation** option.)

The first time a user connects in the extended authentication mode, a certificate is generated for the user. However, the below restrictions apply untilthe generated certificate is confirmed by a manager or administrator:

- ·The account can't be used for connection from the Administrator or Manager terminal.
- ·Connection from client terminals is only possible in the investor mode, without the possibility to trade.

After generating the certificate, an email is sent to the terminal via the internal mail system, explaining which actions should be taken next to confirm the certificate (for example, the user should callthe specified number). The emailtemplate is located under [trade server installation directory\templates\certificate\]. Edit the template for your specific company.

As soon as the user takes the required steps described in the email, the administrator or manager can confirm the user certificate on the **Security** tab of the account.
