### **Importing tick data**

Tick data is imported similarly to minute data. The relevant command should be run from the **Bid/Ask/Last Ticks** section. Again, you can use separate data files or folders. All settings in import dialogs are the same.

## **Copying data from another symbol**

For newly created symbols with an empty price history, it is possible to copy data from another symbol in the platform. In the "Source" field of the new symbol specify the name of the symbolfrom which you want to copy data. The server will automatically copy the entire history.

As soon as the data copying is complete, delete the value from the **Source** field of the new symbol.

Copying is only performed if the new symbol has no price data.

## <span id="page-260-0"></span>**Common errors**

- · Do not truncate the available price history in an effort to save the disk space on your server. It is criticalfor traders to be able to test their strategies and to conduct technical analysis. At the very least, you should download a deep history of forex pairs from the MetaQuotes-Demo server. It is free and requires almost no configuration.
  - · If the "old tick" error appears in client terminal journals, check trade server time settings. The platform could erroneously switch to to or from daylight saving time.
  - · If the "quotes stream stopped" error appears in the gateway or data feed journal, you should check the accessibility of the data source. If the issue is not caused by the source, check your network settings. The gateway must be able to connect to the main trade server and to the history server.
  - · Do not disable quote filtering in symbol settings. Recovery from a price spike can be a very long and timeconsuming process, which can also negatively affect your reputation.

## <span id="page-261-0"></span>**Additional services**

The MetaTrader 5 platform features the ultimate set of tools to provide access to financial markets. However, every business has its specifics, requirements and its own area of interest. To cover 100% of business needs, the platform provides ample opportunities for customization and integration with third-party systems:

- · App [Store](#page-267-0) with hundreds of ready-made solutions from third-party developers. The store features server plugins, reports, exchange integration and web integration solutions, and much more.
- · Five [APIs](#page-262-0) for your own developments. If you do not want to depend on third-party developers, you can implement integration solutions in-house. API has detailed documentation with source code examples.

Also, the platform provides native integration with [messengers](#page-269-0) and mail [services](#page-282-0). Configure them to obtain advanced client onboarding and customer management opportunities.

In addition, the platform provides:

- · Turnkey solution for [hedge](#page-284-0) funds. Control investors and managers, automate chart calculations, reporting and other fund activities.
- · Liquidity [aggregation](#page-298-0) solution. Create a full-fledged ECN based on your platform. An example of such use is the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange (PMEX), which is based on MetaTrader 5.
- · Solution for providing [additional](#page-310-0) services for traders. Start offering high-quality market data, personal manager services, and other paid service through the Subscriptions service.

## <span id="page-262-0"></span>**Server plugins and APIs**

The MetaTrader 5 platform features open APIs which allow further expansion of the platform capabilities, integration with other trading systems and back-office components, as well as platform customization to fit specific business needs.

The platform provides five APIs and an additional option enabling real-time data export to an SQL database.

- · Server API offers tools for expanding the functionality and customizing the MetaTrader 5 server operation logic: custom commissioning and swap calculation algorithms, routing of financial operations, and more. The API provides ready-made examples for expanding the Web and Manager API protocols.
- · Manager API provides functions for developing and editing accounts, depositing and withdrawing funds, processing trade requests and managing the server settings. The API is available as C++ interfaces (32 and 64-bit DLL library) with source code examples.
- · Gateway API enables the creation of custom gateways and data feeds to integrate the MetaTrader 5 platform with other trading systems. Using the Gateway API, you can implement the execution and synchronization of orders and positions with an external system, create and edit trading symbols, provide quotes, and more.
- · Report API provides a set of tools for developing custom reports for MetaTrader 5 Manager. To use these features, you need to write specially designed reports modules as DLLs. The API supports multithreading and memory management, enables the creation of HTML reports and contains ready-made use cases.
- · Web API provides an open text-based protocolfor integrating the MetaTrader 5 platform with web resources and other services of a company. The API allows creating and editing client trade accounts via a website, as well as deposit and withdraw funds directly from a trader's room in realtime
- · Export to SQL is a standard real-time export of data to an SQL database allows for generating various reports: reconciliation of orders, deals and positions with external systems; regularity and risk management reports. For further details please see section Data Export to SQL and [Operations](#page-124-0) with DBMS.

See also: [Documentation](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/docs/mt5/api) / API

## **Setting up server plugins**

Plugins in the form of DLL files enhance the trading platform functionality. They can also change algorithms of some operations performed by the server. For example, you can use plugins to amend margin or swap calculation methods. Create your own plugins using the Server API or purchase ready-made solutions from the App [Store.](#page-267-0)

Plugins are configured separately for each trade server. Save the required DLL file to [server directory\plugins] and create a new configuration in the Administrator terminal:

![](_page_263_Picture_4.jpeg)

Set plugin parameters:

· **Enable** — enable/disable the plugin. The plugin starts running immediately after the option is enabled and the configuration is saved. No server restart is required to get started. If you disable the option, the server will completely unload the plugin from memory. This enables update of plug-in DLL files without the need to restart the platform.

- · **Configurable by managers** — if this option is enabled, the settings of this plugin can be edited via the Manager terminal. In order to be able to manage plugin configurations, the Manager account must have the [Configure](#page-75-0) plugins permission.
- · **Enable plugin profiling** — in this mode, the server will start collecting plugin operation statistics, based on which you can evaluate plugin performance and detect possible operation problems. Do not keep this parameter permanently enabled, because it affects the plugin performance.
- ·**Name** — the name of the plugin configuration.
- · **Module** — select one of the plugin modules in the first field. This field displays allthe plugins located in the "plugins" folder of the server selected in the next field. Each plugin configuration is bound to a specific trade server and thus it only influences the operation of this server.

Additional parameters are configured in the bottom part. The set of parameters depends on the plugin.

The **Information** section displays the plugin description, copyright, author and version and the version of the MetaTrader 5 Server API used for its development.

#### **Profiling**

Profiling allows evaluating the performance of the plugin by measuring the event handler and hook calltimes. Measurement is performed for each event and hook available in the plugin.

After you enable profiling, the server will begin to collect plugin operation statistics and will print information to the Journal every 5 minutes. Use the Profile keyword to request logs.

- · The profiling mode is only recommended for the plugin testing time, because this mode slows down the plugin operation.
- · Profiling should be enabled prior to enabling the plugin itself. If the plugin is already running, then you should restart it after enabling profiling. This is necessary for the correct collection of information.

The following information is provided during profiling:

· **Hook/event handler state** — active state (the hook/handler is being executed at the measurement time), unactive state (the hook/handler is not being executed at the measurement time). If the hook/handler is active for more than 5 seconds, the system displays a possible deadlock message in the log (the second entry in the example). If the hook/handler is active for more than 0.5 seconds, the system adds a message about the hook/handler being too slow (the third entry in the example).

```
14:10:01 Simple Plugin Profile IMTConSymbolSink::OnSymbolUpdate: unactive state
14:10:01 Simple Plugin Profile IMTConSymbolSink::OnSymbolUpdate: possible
deadlock: 6000 msc in active state
14:10:01 Simple Plugin Profile IMTConSymbolSink::OnSymbolUpdate: too slow: max
process time 1000 msc
```

·**Call count** — X calls, the total number of hook/handler calls for during the plagun operation time. 14:10:01 Simple Plugin Profile IMTConSymbolSink::OnSymbolUpdate: 5 calls

·**Last call time** — the time when the hook/handler was called for the last time up to milliseconds.

```
14:10:01 Simple Plugin Profile IMTConSymbolSink::OnSymbolUpdate: last call at
2013.06.26 14:09:37.603
```

· **Minimum execution time** — time min, minimum hook/handler execution time during the plugin operation time, in milliseconds.

```
14:10:01 Simple Plugin Profile IMTConSymbolSink::OnSymbolUpdate: time min 0
msc
```

· **Maximum execution time** — time max, maximum hook/handler execution time during the plugin operation time, in milliseconds.

```
14:10:01 Simple Plugin Profile IMTConSymbolSink::OnSymbolUpdate: time max 2
msc
```

· **Average execution time** — time avg, average hook/handler execution time during the plugin operation time, in milliseconds.

```
14:10:01 Simple Plugin Profile IMTConSymbolSink::OnSymbolUpdate: time avg 0
msc
```

· Total execution time — time total, total hook/handler execution time (time of all calls in milliseconds) during the plugin operation time, in milliseconds.

14:10:01 Simple Plugin Profile IMTConSymbolSink::OnSymbolUpdate: time total 0 msc

#### **Configuring access servers to work with Web API**

Access servers support connection via HTTPS protocol(HTTP is not supported). Therefore, they can act as a web server. This enables sending of Web API commands to a server as ordinary GET and POST requests.

To enable connection to the access server via HTTPS, at least one of its public addresses (specified in the **Network** section) must be associated with a certain domain, i.e. the host to which POST and GET requests will be implemented. For this purpose, the appropriate entry must be specified on the DNS server. For example, if you want to implement operation via the host abc.broker.com, the following entry should be added to DNS: XXX.XXX.XXX.XXX abc.broker.com, where XXX.XXX.XXX.XXX is the public address of the access server.

Since only protected TLS connections (HTTPS) are supported, an SSL certificate must be installed on the access server for the appropriate domain. Use the **SSL** section in the appropriate server settings to download and manage certificates:

| <b>SSL Certificates</b><br>Please specify server SSL certificates for all access servers. They will be used for connections made through them.                                                                                                                                           |                                          |                                          |             |               |                   |            |                                          |                                          |

The certificate can be password protected. In this case, you will be prompted to enter the password. This password is only used for certificate installation on the local computer and is not transmitted anywhere.

SSL settings apply to all access servers, not just to the one in which you edit them. Changes in the list of certificates are applied instantly, so you do not need to restart the servers.

Connections from multiple domains can be supported on one server (the SNI [mode](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/Server_Name_Indication)). In this case, the corresponding SSL certificate must be installed for each of them. When connecting, the client specifies the address to connect to. The access server checks all installed certificates and automatically provides the necessary one to the client:

- ·First, the server tries to find a certificate for an exact match domain.
- ·If not, it tries to find the most suitable one using mask \*.
- ·If the certificate could not be found, the server returns the first certificate from the list.

Select OK to complete a access server creation or editing. If you select Cancel, the window will be closed without saving changes.

### **Intelligent budget optimization system**

Various factors affect the delivery of confirmation codes to traders, such as the provider, the trader's country and carrier, roaming, and so on. Codes can be delivered with a delay in some cases. To avoid frequent repeated quote requests, confirmation codes are valid for three hours. If the code is not entered in the field within this time frame, the trader will need to repeat the procedure.

Before sending codes, the system checks whether the specified phone/email was previously confirmed. If the trader has already passed verification from his or her computer in the last 72 hours, an account will be opened without additional confirmation. Thus, there will be no additional burden for traders and no additional costs for brokers.

The system automatically controls the correctness of specified phone numbers on the client terminal side. This prevents the sending of codes to incorrect numbers and thus saves you costs for the SMS provider services.

- · The phone number must be specified in the internationalformat: +[country code][number], for example: +79171113594. The number is indicated without spaces.
- ·This must be a mobile phone number, not landline.

The number of confirmations of different phone numbers that a trader can request from one computer is limited for security purposes. When the limit is reached, confirmation codes are no longer sent, and the following messages is printed in the server log: "too many phone confirmation requests from IP".

### <span id="page-270-0"></span>**Use multiple providers to enable the system to choose the optimal one**

We recommend working with at least two different SMS providers at the same time, in order to ensure successful and fast delivery. To reduce costs and to increase the delivery success rate, the platform will collect statistics on sent SMS for each country and provider: successful attempts, errors, cost.

| Country                           | Sent | Errors | Spent                | Average Price       |
|-----------------------------------|------|--------|----------------------|---------------------|
| +357 (Cyprus)                     | 3    |        | 2.40 CRD / 0.07 USD  | 0.80 CRD / 0.02 USD |
| +7 (Kazakhstan, Russia)           | 5    | 1      | 10.00 CRD / 0.30 USD | 2.00 CRD / 0.06 USD |
| +380 (Ukraine)                    |      | 1      |                      |                     |
| Balance: 8726.30 CRD / 261.79 USD | 8    |        | 12.40 CRD / 0.37 USD | 1.55 CRD / 0.05 USD |

How the provider is selected when sending a message:

- ·The system checks the client group and country
- · The best provider is selected from the list of providers meeting the [country](#page-278-0) and [group](#page-279-0) conditions, based on the number of successfully delivered messages and message cost

- ·If several providers have the same statistics, the one located further up the list is selected
- · If none of the providers is suitable, the default provider is utilized (as set by the **Default messenger** option in **Common** settings)

If sending through the main provider fails, the system will send the message through the next one.

By connecting multiple SMS providers, you can minimize the probability of losing a client due to an undelivered message.

A successfully delivered verification code is valid for 3 hours. Thus, a trader can open a real account even in the event of unforeseen delays due to the network operator fault.

The system also protects against technicalfailures if the optimal SMS provider fails for some reason. If an error is received from the provider, the system willrepeat a sending attempt. All unsuccessful attempts are accumulated in the counter. Once the limit is reached, the system switches to another available provider. Thus, the system willrepeat attempts untilthe message is successfully sent.

Create a new configuration and set the messaging service connection parameters:

- · **Enable** — enable/disable messenger configuration. If the configuration is disabled, the service will not be used to send messages.
- ·**Name** — configuration name.
- · **Type** — messaging service provider. Parameters are provider-specific so you should check them with your provider. #### <span id="page-280-0"></span>**Templates**

Templates can be used for messages. The text can be changed depending on the used message provider or the recipient country.

Each country has its own message sending rules: providers can filter messages by specific words, require special formats, etc. For example, in China it is recommended to indicate a [signature](https://support.twilio.com/hc/en-us/articles/360016612253-China-SMS-Template-Pre-approval-Requests) before a message. Please check with your message provider for specific sending policies.

Use templates to customize message sending in accordance with localrules.

For example, a template from the file [main server installation directory]\templates\verify\_phone is used for phone number confirmation during account registration. You can specify in this template a macro for code substitution, without a text: "<!--CONFIRMATION\_CODE-->". Further, the required text can be added in the provider settings:

A basic template is set in the general provider settings. It contains the default #MESSAGE# macro which substitutes the source text. In our example, the text "*Confirmation code*" is added so that the resulting message will look as follows: *Confirmation code: [confirmation code]*.

Country-specific templates are set in country settings. These templates have higher priority than basic ones. If a country template is specified, this template will be used. Otherwise a template from the **Common** tab will be used.

## <span id="page-282-0"></span>**Integration with mail services**

The MetaTrader 5 platform features the built-in email service. Use the system to send internal emails and trading reports to traders, as well as to enable the validation of email addresses specified by users when opening accounts via client terminals.

Reports and verification emails can be sent from different mailboxes, while a separate mailbox can be used for each client group. Thus your White Label partners can send emails to their clients from their own addresses.

Create a new configuration and set the mail server parameters:

- · **Enable** — enable/disable the mail server configuration. If the configuration is disabled, emails will not be sent via this server.
- ·**Name** — configuration name.
- ·**Sender email** — email address from which emails will be sent.
- ·**Sender name** — sender name which will be indicated in emails.
- · **SMTP server** — email server address for sending reports and port number, separated by a colon. Example: smtp.mailserver.com:80.
- ·**SMTP login** — account login on the mail server.

- ·**Password** — account password on the mail server.
- · **Default server** — the special **Default** option can be selected for the used mail server in group settings and in account allocation settings. In this case the platform will check the list of all servers and will utilize the first available server having the **Default server** option enabled.

Sent email statistics is shown for each configuration in the list:

- ·**Total Sent / Errors** — number of sent emails and number of unsent emails due to errors.
- ·**Queue** — number of emails on the queue to be sent.
- ·**Min / Max / Avg time** — minimum, maximum and average time of sending one email, in milliseconds.

## <span id="page-284-0"></span>**Funds and ETFs**

MetaTrader 5 platform offers a turnkey solution for mutualfunds, prop trading and investment companies right out of the box. MetaTrader 5 Administrator allows creating a fund, swiftly configuring payouts and commissions, adding managers and opening trading accounts for investors.

All calculations related to share values, profitability and payouts are performed automatically in realtime. Fund clients are able to monitor their investments directly from the MetaTrader 5 client terminal like ordinary traders.

## **Automation capabilities**

MetaTrader 5 enables the automation of fund operations:

- · Manage investors and keep detailed records of investments. Fund management is performed according to a traditional scheme adopted in the platform: you create investor accounts, add relevant investment amounts to their balances and add these accounts to a specialfund investors section.
- · Work with fund managers. Similarly to investors, managers are added in the system in the form of regular trading accounts. Invested assets are credited to these accounts and are further used to perform trading operations.
- · Automatically build charts reflecting assets under management (AUM). The invested money is credited to regular trading accounts, in which it is used by the fund managers for trading (management). The platform automatically builds the AUM charts based on the account equity data and taking into account applicable management and success fees. Investors can view this chart in the desktop, mobile and web terminals by connecting using their trading accounts, similar to regular traders.
- · Automate the calculation of fees and payments to investors. You do not need to use third-party accounting systems. The platform provides flexible fund settings, which include the hurdle rate, fees, fee calculation frequency, and payment mode among others.
- · Provide real-time fund performance information to investors. Investors can view the fund charts and the current value of the shares by simply connecting to the trading account via the MetaTrader 5 desktop, mobile or web terminal.
- ·Receive fund performance reports.

Set up the following parameters under the **Common** section:

- ·**Name** — the fund name.
- ·**Symbol** — the name of the trading symbol, in which the [NAV](#page-296-0) will be reflected.
- ·**Assets symbol** — the name of the trading symbol, in which a change in the [AUM](#page-296-1) will be shown.
- ·**Performance symbol** — the name of the trading symbol, which willreflect the fund [performance](#page-296-2) chart.
- · **Trade server** — the trade server, on which the fund will be managed. Only accounts opened on the selected server can be used to created [investors](#page-293-0) and fund [managers.](#page-292-0) They can't be created on different servers.

- · **Administrating manager** — the account of the manager, who will administer the fund. The field is currently not used. In the future, the field will be used to grant separate permissions to access the fund reports, as well as to change the lists of investors and managers.
- <span id="page-288-0"></span>· **Recalculation** — fund charts [calculation](#page-296-3) mode:
  - · **Every minute** — the fund chart is recalculated every minute, after which appropriate quotes are added to the symbols' price stream.
  - · **Every hour** — the fund chart is recalculated every hour, after which appropriate quotes are added to the symbols' price stream.
  - · **Daily** — the fund chart is recalculated at the end of each trading session, after which appropriate quotes are added to the symbols' price stream.
  - · **Manually** — the platform does not calculate fund performance variables and does not generate charts. This mode should be used when broadcasting fund data from external sources via gateways or data feeds.
- · **Type** — fund type:
  - · **Open-end** — the shares of such a fund can be purchased or sold at any day. The assets of the fund can be freely increased or decreased.
  - · **Closed-end** — unlike the previous type, the capital of such a fund can't be changed. The fund issues a limited number of shares, which will not change in the future.
- · **Period** — the fund lifetime. The platform performs any operations concerning the fund (such as calculations, charting, fee charging) only within the specified period.
- · **Maximum capital** — the maximum allowable amount of investments within the fund. Investors and their shares are managed under a [separate](#page-293-0) section of fund settings. When the investment amount reaches the specified value, the platform will prevent from further adding of new investors or from increase of shares of existing investors.
- <span id="page-288-1"></span>· **Currency** — the currency in which allthe fund variables are calculated: prices, commissions, etc. For example, AUM (Assets under Management) is calculated based on the funds on trading [accounts.](#page-292-0) If the trading account deposit currency is GBP, while the fund currency is USD, the funds will be converted at the current GBPUSD rate when calculating AUM.
- · **Maximum investors** — the maximum number of investors who can purchase the fund shares (specified under a [separate](#page-293-0) section of fund settings).

#### **Configure payments and fees**

The MetaTrader 5 trading platform enables the automation of all calculations concerning the fund: management fees and payments of returns.

Before configuring payments, you should create a separate trading account for each fund: allrelevant payments will be performed in this account (Fees account). It is recommended to create a separate group for such

accounts, while this enables more convenient work with accounts (including granting of appropriate access permissions to managers).

#### <span id="page-289-0"></span>**Management fees**

The company which manages the fund, charges investors a certain fee for the services. This is usually equalto a percentage of the [NAV](#page-296-1). This is referred to as the management fees. Allrelevant calculation parameters are specified under the fund's **Fees** section:

- · **Distribution** — fee distribution mode. If Automatic, the fee will be calculated by the platform. The Report mode enables manual calculation using external data.
- ·**Period** — fee calculation and distribution frequency: daily, monthly, quarterly or yearly.
- <span id="page-289-1"></span>·**Fees account** — a specialtrading account, to which fund management fees will be credited.
- · **Management fee** — the fund management fee as a percentage of [AUM.](#page-296-1) The calculation can also be based on assets values as of the beginning of the calculation period, end of period, or as an average value over a period. For example, if you select quarterly or period beginning calculation, the specified percentage will be calculated based on AUM as of the end of the previous quarter.

Management Fee is calculated using the following formula:

#### Management Fee = (Fund Equity \* Days \* Management Fee Percent/100)/365

where:

- ·'Fund Equity' is the fund value at the time of calculation
- ·'Days' is the calculation period
- ·'Management Fee Percent' is the management fee in percent

On a selected basis, the platform will calculate the management fees and willtransfer the relevant amount to the special account, which is specified in the fund settings (Fees account). The accrual is performed as a balance operation of Commission type, with a comment "MF '[Fund Name]'". For example, "MF 'ENTHIGH'".

The fees account balance is taken into account when [calculating](#page-296-3) fund values, including its AUM. Actually, each management fee transfer reduces the fund's AUM by an appropriate amount. Nothing is deducted from [investor](#page-293-0) [accounts](#page-293-0).

#### <span id="page-290-0"></span>**Success fee**

In the case of successfulfund management (profitable trading), the company may charge an additionalfee, the so-called Success fee. If during the selected period the AUM value increases by the amount, which is equalto or exceeds the threshold value (Hurdle rate), additional commission will be deducted from the fees account. All related calculation parameters are specified under the **Fees** section.

- ·Distribution, Period, Fees accounts — these parameters are common for [management](#page-289-0) fee and access fee.
- · Success fee — fee as a percentage of the totalreturns for the current period or of the profit above the Hurdle Rate (defined in the Calculation box). The returns are determined separately for each share. Actually, it is performed by the position on the [investor](#page-293-0) account. The success fee calculation mode is also specified here: before or after management fee calculation. The management fee affects the AUM value, which is taken into account during performance calculation. Therefore the success fee value is affected by its calculation time.
- · Calculation — determines the amount based on which success fee will be calculated: the total yield amount for the current period or the amount above the hurdle rate.
- · High water mark — the fund management success can be determined using different methods. Currently only the most popular method is supported in the platform: High water mark. In accordance with this method, management in the calculation period is considered successful if the increase per share (positions on the investor account) exceeds the hurdle rate. You can select how the excess shall be determined: over the entire fund management period, the last year or the last quarter.
- · Hurdle rate is the threshold rate of return. If exceeded during the selected period (specified in "High water mark"), the fund management is considered successful and a commission fee will be charged.

The calculated success fee is deducted from investor accounts as a balance operation of "Commission" type with a comment "SF '[Fund Name]'". For example, "SF 'ENTHIGH'". Further this amount is transferred to the [Fees](#page-289-1) [account](#page-289-1) as a Commission operation. A comment for this operation is specified as "SF '[Fund Name]'-'[Investor account from which the commission has been debited]'". For example, "SF 'ENTHIGH'-'1235966'".

For each position on investor accounts, the platform performs the following actions:

- · Determines the Hurdle rate of the share (position): Maximum share value (NAV) over the High water mark period + NAV Hurdle Rate. The platform calculates the maximum position value over the entire time, over the last year or over the last quarter, depending on the **High water mark** parameter. The position value is calculated as volume multiplied by [NAV](#page-296-0), its maximum value is searched in the price history of the appropriate symbol. Then Hurdle rate percentage of this amount is calculated and added to the total value.
- · Then the platform checks if share profit exceeded the hurdle rate: NAV at the end of the period – Hurdle rate. It means that the platform uses the position value as at the calculation time (before or after charging the management fee) and deducts the hurdle rate calculated at the previous stage, from the position value.
- · The share value (NAV) is determined: NAV at the end of the period – Maximum NAV over the High water mark period. The values are calculated as shown in previous points.
- · If the share profit is negative (loss), zero, or it does not exceed the Hurdle Rate, the success fee is not charged.
- · If the share profit exceeds the Hurdle Rate, the success fee is calculated in accordance with the Calculation field value:

- ·Soft: Profit per share \* Success fee. The fee is calculated as percentage of share profit calculated above.
- · Hard: Profit beyond the Hurdle Rate \* Success fee.
  - · The Fees account balance is taken into account when calculating the [AUM.](#page-296-1) Thus, charging of any management fees reduces the AUM value.
  - · Use a separate trading account for each fund's Fees account. Do not perform any other operations on this account.

It is recommended to create a separate group for such accounts, while this enables more convenient work with the accounts (for example, generation of relevant reports). Then transfer the investors' funds to these accounts, for example, by performing balance operations using the Manager terminal.

#### <span id="page-293-0"></span>**Set the investors**

The fund investors are also managed using trading accounts.

### **Allocation of additional shares**

If you need to allocate additional shares within an already running fund, please pay attention to the following:

- · After allocating shares for new investors (opening positions on their accounts) and adding investors to the list, do not forget to distribute their invested funds between relevant managers' accounts. Otherwise, the NAV chart will be incorrect as the number of units has increased, while the management funds have not. Funds are distributed between managers at your discretion.
- · To avoid incorrect NAV values before you distribute funds between manager accounts, you can temporarily disable the fund. This will pause the calculation of charts. After completing the setup, turn the fund back on.
- · If incorrect prices were still added to the fund charts, you can delete such prices via the **1 Minute History Chars** and **Bid/Ask/Last Ticks** sections.

### <span id="page-296-3"></span>**Assets under management, Net asset value, the NAV chart**

The trading platform allows tracking the fund yield dynamics in realtime, similarly to tracking of common symbol quotes.

As described above, ordinary trading [instruments](#page-286-0) are created for the fund. The platform automatically records the changes in net asset value (NAV), assets under management (AUM) and profitability into the price history of these symbols.

These charts are calculated at intervals, specified in the [Recalculation](#page-288-0) field. After each calculation, a quote with the appropriate fund value is added to the symbols' price history.

#### <span id="page-296-1"></span>**Assets under management (AUM)**

Fund AUM value is used for calculating [management](#page-289-0) fees and [commission](#page-290-0) fees, as well as for calculating other fund charts. It is calculated according to the following formula:

(The total amount of equity on the fund's trading accounts – Management fee)

The platform calculates the total amount of equity on alltrading [accounts](#page-292-0) of the fund and subtracts from the resulting value the management fee amount. The trading account deposit currency differing from the [fund](#page-288-1) [currency](#page-288-1) is converted at the current rate.

#### <span id="page-296-0"></span>**Net asset value (NAV)**

The value is calculated according to the following formula:

#### AUM / Number of fund shares

AUM value calculated by the previous formula is divided by the current [number](#page-293-0) of shares allocated by the fund to its investors.

#### <span id="page-296-2"></span>**Fund performance**

The value is calculated according to the following formula:

#### Previous-period Performance + log(Current-period AUM / Previous-period AUM)

where:

- · Previous-period Performance — for the first value on the chart this formula element is ignored. For the first period, the previous period performance will be zero.
- ·Current-period AUM is calculated according to the AUM formula specified above.
- · Previous-period AUM is also calculated according to the above AUM formula, but for the previous period. The amount of funds deposited during the calculation period is added to this value (the money [distributed](#page-292-0) at the beginning of the calculation period between managers).

Period refers to the chart calculation periodicity, specified in the [Recalculation](#page-288-0) field. If charts are recalculated once a minute, the previous period is equalto the previous minute.

### **Resetting the fund state**

The fund state can be reset using two commands in the settings dialog:

- · Recalculation — fullrecalculation of fund charts: NAV, AUM and performance. The platform reproduces the entire fund history based on manager and investor accounts: investment operations, share purchases, and other operations. The graph history is calculated and recorded based on this data.
- · Reset — resetting accumulated statistics used for the calculation of fund parameters, including commissions. Use this option if you need to restart the fund and exclude previously accumulated values from further calculations. For example, this operation may be needed after testing.

Use these commands with caution. Deleted values can't be recovered.

## <span id="page-298-0"></span>**Built-in ECN**

Brokers can implement their own ECN (Electronic Communication Network) in the MetaTrader 5 trading platform. Use the ECN to provide liquidity alongside the best execution prices for your clients. You can additionally profit from order matching and markups. Using the built-in ECN functionality, you can become a fullfledged liquidity provider for other companies and implement your own trading facilities.

MetaTrader5-based ECN implementation does not require much time and money. Liquidity providers can be easily connected to the network via gateways. Using the ready-made MetaTrader 5 — [MetaTrader](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/market/product/267) 4 and [MetaTrader](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/market/product/266) 5 — MetaTrader 5 gateways, you can connect any broker to the ECN via a regular trading account. Deploy the ECN without complicated pre-integration procedures.

The ECN configuration consists of a few simple steps:

- 1. Enable ECN
- 2. Create and configure financial instruments, including the minimum spread for order book aggregation
- 3. Configure quote sources and markups
- 4. Configure routing of trade requests to the ECN for processing
- 5. Configure trade request processing and matching rules

### **Enable ECN**

Firstly, you should enable the ECN module in the platform:

![](_page_299_Picture_3.jpeg)

The general system operation statistics are displayed here, such as the number of matched orders, and generated ticks.

## **Create financial instruments for liquidity aggregation**

Select symbols to aggregate liquidity from different providers in your platform. We recommend [creating](#page-201-0) a separate set of instruments for [aggregation,](#page-201-0) though you can also use existing ones. However, note that current positions for these instruments will be processed via ECN instead of the previously used liquidity providers.

For operation convenience, create ECN symbols in a special subgroup and use specific names. For example, you can create a ECN group and add symbols with the suffix .ECN to it, such as EURUSD.ECN and GBPUSD.ECN. You can use any suffixes provided they are clear to you and your traders. Such symbol preparation will enable efficient operation in the future.

These recommended trading symbol usage principles also apply to gateways without the ECN. For example, if you use the Currenex and LMAX gateways, you should create a set of symbols with meaningful suffixes for each of them, for example, EURUSD.CNX and GBPUSD.LMX. This provides better control over data sources as compared to price feeding to general symbols. The properly suffixed names also enable the allocation of different liquidity access permissions to traders by specifying relevant symbol masks in group settings.

Then add the created symbols to the ECN:

## **Configure liquidity providers: you can select any MetaTrader brokers**

The ECN enables aggregation of price data from three source types: gateways, data feeds, and clients within the platform. The basic usage scenario implies connection of external systems via gateways. This is the standard integration method, which is used by many brokerage companies.

Ready-made provider connection solutions are available in the App [Store](#page-267-0). You can use the MetaTrader 5 — MetaTrader 4 and MetaTrader 5 — MetaTrader 5 gateways to connect any broker to the ECN via a regular trading account. Deploy the ECN without complicated pre-integration procedures.

#### **Price liquidity and Market Depth availability to clients**

The aggregated Depth of Market (order book) of an ECN symbol can contain two order types:

- · Liquid orders which can be used to match client orders. These include orders from the gateways which are connected to the ECN as a dealer and which are added to the matching rule, as well as orders from traders within the cluster. The utilized gateways must support ECN operation (which is available by default in MetaQuotes' liquidity gateways).
- · Illiquid orders, which can't be utilized in matching. These include prices from data feeds, as well as quotes from gateways which do not participate in matching.

Only liquid orders can form best prices in the order book for traders (Best Bid/Best Ask). If a price is illiquid and it is currently the best one among all prices, it will not be shown in the Market Depth for traders. In other words, illiquid prices are shown in the trader order book only if they are not the best. For further details please see [documentation.](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/docs/mt5/platform/administration/ecn/ecn_dom_aggregation#dom_clients)

The Market Depth level liquidity and visibility flags can be checked from the ECN \ Market Depth journal.

The rules provide an instruction of how to match orders:

- ·Specify order selection rules under the **Conditions** section, such as volume, client group, date, and time.
- · In Providers, specify the systems via which the orders will be executed. These may include your gateways, as well as the MetaTrader 5 cluster to match requests between your clients. The order of providers in the

list affects order processing. For example, if the MT5 provider is specified before the Currenex gateway, the ECN will match orders within the cluster, if possible. If a suitable counter order is not found, the system will match with external system orders.

·The **Filling** tab features advanced matching settings. They can be configured later.

#### **How the matching is performed**

The ECN maintains a list of orders waiting to be matched. The list is formed in accordance with the aforementioned routing rules. Orders are processed in a loop:

- ·The ECN picks up an order from the list, according to the type, price and creation time.
- ·Based on the matching rules, the ECN determines a suitable opposite order.
- · If a client order within your trading platform is used for matching, the ECN will execute appropriate deals in both accounts.
- · If an external system order is used for matching, the ECN willform and send an appropriate order to it via a gateway.

See also: [Documentation](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/docs/mt5/platform/administration/ecn/ecn_matching#settings) / Platform / Platform Settings / ECN / Order matching

This completes the basic ECN setup. Quotes from selected sources will be aggregated in the ECN symbol order books, the ECN will accept trade requests for these symbols and it will add client orders to the aggregated order book for further execution. Client orders will be matched with each other or executed in an external system via a gateway.

you can view the current order queue execution state in the ECN \ [Matching](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/docs/mt5/platform/administration/ecn/ecn_matching_history) section, and processed orders and deals (executed or rejected) in the ECN \ [Matching](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/docs/mt5/platform/administration/ecn/ecn_matching_history#history) history section.

For example, the EURUSD.USR symbolreceives a EURUSD.ECN order book with a markup of -4/+5. To display client orders for this symbol in the EURUSD.USR order book, create the following rule:

- · Specify zero markups (0/0), because EURUSD.USR symbol users should see their initial price orders in the Market Depth.
- ·Specify the EURUSD.USR symbolto show the related orders in the order book.
- · Specify order types (All) and selection conditions, similar to the routing rule, to forward EURUSD.USR orders to the ECN.

If you also wish to display source symbol(.ECN) orders in the translated symbol order books, create similar aggregation rules with inverse markups (-5/4).

If you do not need re-translation to other instruments, you can configure markups for the original ECN symbols using this method. Specify them as a source and as a receiver in the rules.

There are some other markup configuration methods apart from translation settings:

· Minimum spread — automatic conversion of ECN Market Depth prices if the current spread as per data aggregated from different sources is less than the specified one.

- ·Gateways settings — adding markups when receiving prices from an external system.
- ·Group setting — adding markups when sending prices to a specific client group.

See also: [Documentation](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/docs/mt5/platform/administration/ecn/ecn_translation) / Platform / Platform settings / ECN / Price translations

### **Additional features and advanced settings**

This topic only covers the basic setup allowing you to quickly launch an ECN and view its capabilities. However, the system has many advanced settings and functions, which enable fine system adjustment for unique tasks and conditions:

- ·Order forwarding and execution modes
- ·Profitable and unprofitable slippage
- ·Aggregation conditions
- ·Order book control and other settings

Allfunctions are described in detail in the documentation.

## <span id="page-310-0"></span>**Subscriptions for additional trader services**

With the new Subscriptions service, you can expand your offerings and attract more clients.

- ·Fee-based high-quality market data from reputable vendors
- ·Personal manager services to help users in learning trading basics
- ·One-time services such as position transferring or currency conversion, and much more.

The MetaTrader 5 already includes a completely prepared infrastructure:

- · The product showcase will be available to all your traders. You set up products via the Administrator terminal and the subscriptions instantly appear in client terminals. It means that you will not have to additionally attract traders to your site.
- · Payment is made directly from a trading account. Traders can easily pay for the product, as they do not have to think which payment methods to use. The easy procedure can increase the probability of a successful purchase.
- · Automated delivery of market data and news. Traders start receiving the data immediately after purchasing a subscription. Once you set up the subscriptions, you do not need to perform any additional manual actions.
- · You maintain a single database. Information on subscriptions is linked to trading accounts in the platform. You can view the history of purchases and generate reports.

![](_page_311_Picture_1.jpeg)

Start developing new paid products to boost your business success!

See also: Articles / Market data [subscriptions](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/articles/1014) in MetaTrader 5

#### **Subscription payments**

Subscription fees are paid directly from the trading account balance. Traders will not need to visit other websites, as payments will be made automatically within the platform.

A payment is deducted from the account as a balance operation of *commission* type. The following comment is added to the operation: Subscription 'Subscription name'.

To start receiving data, the trader purchases a subscription in the terminal:

- · At this moment, the appropriate amount is debited from the user's trading account balance (for paid subscriptions).
- ·An appropriate subscription record is created, indicating the subscription expiration date.

- · If automated renewal is enabled for a subscription, an attempt to deduct the appropriate amount from the account will be performed upon expiration. If the attempt is successful, the subscription willremain active.
- · If the required amount is not available on the account, the suspended status is set for the subscription. A repeated payment attempt will be made an hour later. Repeated attempts are made within a day. If a payment can't be made during this time, the subscription is canceled.

Since the payment is made from an account balance, subscriptions are only available for real and preliminary accounts.

#### **Creating a subscription**

Before setting up specific configurations, we recommend defining the service structure and creating appropriate categories. For example, "Market Data" and "Manager Services". Categories can be created using the context menu in the sections tree.

![](_page_312_Figure_6.jpeg)

A convenient structure facilitates setup and management as well as increases service convenience for traders.

Next, we'll look at an example of creating a market data subscription. The full description of the service is available in the platform [documentation](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/docs/mt5/platform/administration/subscriptions).

#### **Why traders need market data**

Traders analyze markets and test strategies. They explore new securities, as diversification helps reduce the risks, execute more trading operations and improve the overall stability of trading results. With the Subscriptions service traders can access the required data out of the box.

Traders do not need to use third-party software, to learn MQL5 programming, or to load of data into custom symbols manually. The market data is provided through ordinary symbols, similarly to data provided by brokers for trading. Therefore, traders can use any standard analysis tools available in terminal as follows:

- ·View real-time quotes in Market Watch
- ·View charts and apply indicators or analytical objects
- ·Run Expert Advisors to simulate trading
- ·Test trading ideas in the strategy tester, perform optimization and mathematicaltasks
- ·Analyze prices using Python

These services will always be popular among traders, as they provide a ready-made toolfor expanded trading opportunities.

#### **Preparation**

Before you start offering market data to your traders, you should configure receiving of appropriate symbol data from liquidity providers. The process is similar to adding trading symbols available to traders in the platform:

- ·Create the [required](#page-201-0) symbols
- ·Configure [gateways](#page-226-0) or data feeds to receive data for these symbol
- · To start selling market data, you will need to sign an agreement with appropriate exchanges and trading systems, as the data is proprietary.
- · The support website App [Store](https://support.metaquotes.net/en/market/mt5/aggregation) features a variety of solutions enabling receiving of data from popular liquidity providers.

The following settings are available:

- · Name — the name of the service. It should be short and straightforward. This name will be displayed as the product name in client terminals.
- · Depends on — sets if another product subscription is required in order to subscribe to the current product. Using this option you can create product packages. For example, you can create a paid subscription for US market price data, and a dependent free subscription for Asian market data. In this case, traders having the first subscription will be able to receive the second one for free.
- · Price — subscription cost. Another function enabling separate pricing for non-professional(ordinary traders) and professional(legal entities, brokers, banks) clients is currently under development. The price from the Non-Professionalfields is currently used for all subscriptions.
- · Prime cost — specify your expenses relating to the service provision. For example, if you are reselling market data, you can specify here how much you are paying for the subscription. This will allow you to build reports on the service profitability.

- · Period — the period of the subscription. If the subscription is canceled before the end of the paid period, data delivery will stop immediately, while the fee for of remaining unused time will not be refunded.
- · Free period — subscription trial period. The trading account owner can use the free period once. If the subscription period is extended after the free period (including automatic renewals), the appropriate amount will be paid from the user's account.

Specify the following settings:

- · Auto renew subscription — this option enables automated subscription renewal upon expiration. During renewal, the subscription amount will be automatically debited from the client's trading account.
- · Agreement URL — you can specify here a link to additionalAgreement/Rules to be accepted by the trader. An agreement link will be displayed in the subscription confirmation dialog in client terminals.
- · Permissions — select the subscription actions available to traders:
  - ·Full — the client can subscribe and unsubscribe from the service.
  - · Unsubscribe — the client can only unsubscribe from the service. The subscription can only be created through the Manager terminal or the API. If the user is not subscribed to a service with this permission, the appropriate subscription will not be shown to the trader in the client terminal.
  - · View — the client can view the service in the terminal, but subscribe and unsubscribe options are only available through the Manager terminal or the API. If the user is not subscribed to a service with this permission, the appropriate subscription will not be shown to the trader in the client terminal.
  - · Hidden — clients can't view the service in the terminal, even if they are subscribed to this services (the subscription fee is charged from the trading account, as for regular subscriptions). The subscription can only be created through the Manager terminal or the API.

You can create subscriptions for traders from certain countries. To limit access, specify the list of countries in the appropriate field. To select/deselect all countries in the list, right-click on the list.

Note:

- ·When opening a demo account from the client terminal, the client's country is determined automatically.
- · When opening a preliminary account, the country is also detected automatically, but the client can specify another country in the registration form.
- ·When creating a real account, you specify the country manually.

Similarly, you can limit access, allowing subscriptions only for clients from individual groups.

Restrictions by countries and groups also affect the ability to subscribe through Manager terminals or the API. If the service is not available for the trader, there is no way to subscribe to it.

Specify, which data will be available for each of the symbols or groups:

- <span id="page-317-0"></span>· Level — data type that will be available by subscription:
  - · Delayed — data in the Market Watch in client terminals will be displayed with a [delay](#page-318-0). Depth of Market and tick history will not be available.

- · Level 1 realtime, best Bid/Ask — data in the Market Watch will be displayed in realtime. Depths of Market will not be available.
- · Level 2 realtime — the subscriber willreceive in realtime the best Bid/Ask prices in the Market Watch, as well ad the Depth of Market data.
- ·Available tick history — the tick history depth that will be available by subscription.

#### **Access to symbols on the client terminal side**

Subscription limit general access to trading symbols available in the platform. If a symbol is not used in subscriptions, this symbol can be accessed in a regular way — in accordance with the settings of the group to which the account belongs.

If there is a subscription for the symbol, then access to symbol data (quotes, history, order books, tick history) depends on whether this subscription is available to the trader in accordance with permission settings.

- · If permission settings include the trader's group, then the trader will be able to access the real-time symbol data by subscription. Without a subscription, the trader will only receive [delayed](#page-318-0) data. It means that you do not disable access to symbol data by setting up a subscription. Without a subscription, the trader can still receive the symbol data, but only with a delay.
- · If there are no subscriptions available to this client group, the trader will be able to receive the relevant market data without a subscription. The access will be provided in accordance with the group settings.

Example: you have a EURUSD symbol subscription with access for the real-usd group.

- ·A trader from the real-usd group will need a subscription to receive the EURUSD data.
- · Traders from any other groups willreceive the EURUSD data in accordance with the appropriate group settings, without a subscription.

If the trader has multiple intersecting subscriptions, the maximum subscribed data will be available. For example, if a trader has a subscription for the delayed EURUSD data and a subscription for EURUSD Level 2, then Level 2 data will be available to the trader.

Subscriptions restrict access to data that is originally available to the user group. For example, if only Forex\\* symbols are available to a trader's group, then no subscription can provide access to data from the Stocks\\* group.

#### <span id="page-318-0"></span>**Delayed data**

You can provide market data with a [delay](#page-317-0). For example, this option can be used for a free trial version. A certain delay in quote delivery can also be demanded by some exchanges providing data.

The default delay is 15 minutes. You can override this value for each desired trading instrument.

The delay is specified at this level, because exchanges can have different requirements for each trading instrument. Therefore, you can't create multiple subscriptions for the same trading instrument with different delay values. The value specified in symbol settings will be applied for all subscriptions connected to this instrument.

A restart of the access servers is required for new delay settings to take effect.

This works as follows on the client terminal side:

- ·Quotes in the Market Watch will be received with a delay.
- ·Charts will be updated with a delay.
- ·The current prices for positions and orders in the **Trade** section will be updated with a delay.
- ·Profit by position and account balance will be updated at current prices, without delay.
- · The tick history is only available for the current terminal operation session (deep history is not available, regardless of the subscription settings).
- ·Depths of Market is not be available.
- A special indication is used in client terminals to inform traders about which data is provided with a delay:
  - ·Symbols in Market Watch are marked with a clock icon, and the delay value is displayed in the tooltip
  - ·Data delay notification is displayed on charts
